dogecoin.text: Funding rates for $DOGE have dropped over the past two days and are now near neutral. This confirms the move is not driven by excessive long positioning - another sign the rally is more spot-led. https://t.co/y0HNYIJg92

Futures OI for $DOGE sits at ~$1B - well below the Nov/Dec 2024 average of ~$3B. 7D SMA of futures volume is rising from the bottom, but still near Oct 2024 levels. The rally so far appears more spot-driven, not fueled by leveraged speculation. https://t.co/kgml4Oked6

Since early March, the 3–6M HODL Wave has started to swell. This suggests many bought during the Jan bounce from $0.32 to $0.41. If price returns to those levels, some may look to exit at break even - creating possible resistance ahead for $DOGE. https://t.co/qfGpbxkvEs
15% of $DOGE supply was last moved 6–12 months ago. These are holders who bought before the Nov/Dec rally - and they’re still holding. That’s a strong signal of conviction. https://t.co/8pwNz4Hmo2

If $0.20 is breached, there’s little #Dogecoin supply until $0.31 - the next major URPD cluster. This gap raises the probability of a sharp leg higher, as there's not much resistance in between. Watch for breakout momentum if volume picks up.

URPD shows 7% of $DOGE supply is concentrated at $0.20 - the third-largest cluster after $0.17 and $0.07. This level saw big inflows around Jan 22, but wallets likely bought earlier, raising their cost basis. $0.20 may act as resistance near-term. https://t.co/vHvylx3MdN
